description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to safe prime generation, modular arithmetic, and primality testing, specifically for the SRP (Secure Remote Password) protocol. It includes functions for generating safe primes, checking primality, modular exponentiation, and Montgomery multiplication, with references to big number operations and prime testing routines.

methods.name: trialdiv
methods.description: Performs trial division to check small prime factors of a big integer.

methods.name: sophie_germain
methods.description: Generates a Sophie-Germain prime within a specified range.

methods.name: t_makeconfent
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with a safe prime and generator.

methods.name: t_makeconfent_c
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with a composite safe prime and generator.

methods.name: t_putconfent
methods.description: Outputs a configuration entry to a file.

methods.name: BigIntegerBitLen
methods.description: Returns the bit length of a big integer.

methods.name: BigIntegerCheckPrime
methods.description: Checks if a big integer is prime using a probabilistic test.

methods.name: BigIntegerModInt
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a big integer with an unsigned int.

methods.name: BigIntegerMod
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a big integer with another big integer.
